subject_description: a TV home shopping host in a black suit, white shirt and dark red tie, white made-up face, large black eyes, holding a microphone
initial_pose: standing turned three-quarters to the right, leaning slightly forward, left hand holding the microphone at chest height, right arm extended down to the right with the open palm facing up, closed-lip smile
description: talks to the camera like a lively salesman: the mouth opens and closes over and over as if speaking, and whenever it opens the inside is only a deep crimson bottomless void, no teeth, no tongue; the head nods and tilts a little, the shoulders sway, the hand holding the microphone moves it slightly toward the mouth and back; the open right hand sweeps outward toward the turntable as if showing off the product, then comes back; then settles back into the starting pose
